entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In a few seconds, the convoy came t..."
entries.dialogueText: In a few seconds, the convoy came to a graceful stop in front of the steps of the House. Titus held the door for me as I stepped out.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I ascended the stairs, the doors..."
entries.dialogueText: As I ascended the stairs, the doors swung open, revealing the bare-bones interior of the House. A chamber that my father was forced to form, now ready to script a new chapter with my support.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stepped onto the podium as loud a..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped onto the podium as loud applause echoed around me, the faces of the delegates alight with the promise of the future.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When the hall fell silent, I took a..."
entries.dialogueText: When the hall fell silent, I took a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My loyal subjects...""
entries.dialogueText: "My loyal subjects..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My esteemed countrymen and women...""
entries.dialogueText: "My esteemed countrymen and women..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My fellow citizens...""
entries.dialogueText: "My fellow citizens..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great people of Rizia...""
entries.dialogueText: "Great people of Rizia..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I joined the crowd of people g..."
entries.dialogueText: When I joined the crowd of people gathered inside the building, I was immediately greeted by Manus and Daria, who took me to the ministerial chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Followed by security, we entered th..."
entries.dialogueText: Followed by security, we entered the room. The new constitution of Rizia had been laid out on a table in the center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we exchanged handshakes and form..."
entries.dialogueText: As we exchanged handshakes and formalities with each other, Manus leaned in and whispered in my ear.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Not a word from the nobles. Seems..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not a word from the nobles. Seems like everything is going according to plan."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Well... This is it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... This is it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My aides guided me to the table, pu..."
entries.dialogueText: My aides guided me to the table, pulled out a chair for me and carried over a large leather box with golden etchings.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After I was seated, two aides opene..."
entries.dialogueText: After I was seated, two aides opened the box and held it out for me. Inside, a single pen was cushioned in red velvet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Journalists began snapping photos a..."
entries.dialogueText: Journalists began snapping photos as soon as I grabbed the pen. Everyone looked at me in excitement as they waited for my signature.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I signed the ridiculously large pap..."
entries.dialogueText: I signed the ridiculously large papers.
entries.menuText: Sign the constitution without saying anything.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This delegation of legislative con..."
entries.dialogueText: "This delegation of legislative control -- this DLC -- has been a long time coming. I hope it lives up to all of your expectations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, we entrust our future to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we entrust our future to the hands of those elected to represent Rizia. It's a bold step, but one I believe is right."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must understand it is very dif..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must understand it is very difficult for me to sign this and willingly transfer my powers away. It's a bold step, but one that must be taken."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room broke into applause as I s..."
entries.dialogueText: The room broke into applause as I signed the documents.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room broke into applause."
entries.dialogueText: The room broke into applause.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That was it. With my signature, the..."
entries.dialogueText: That was it. With my signature, the new constitution was in place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a long pause, I stood up. My..."
entries.dialogueText: After a long pause, I stood up. My next step was to declare the constitution in public and appoint Rizia's new head of government.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I gave no thought to the significan..."
entries.dialogueText: I gave no thought to the significance of what I had just done. Instead, the simplicity of the process made me feel nervous -- as if I expected someone to have intervened.

entries.dialogueText: Before we entered inside, the aides handed me a ceremonial silk sash with blue and golden stripes, to be presented to the first prime minister.

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I will not let you or the Kingdom..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not let you or the Kingdom down, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I will not let you down.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will not let you down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, Ms. De Rava... I have de..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, Ms. De Rava... I have decided to appoint Manus instead. I believe this is for the best."

entries.dialogueText: "I hope so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have my trust.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have my trust."

entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I nodded."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, Manus... I have decided..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, Manus... I have decided to appoint Ms. Rava instead. I believe this is for the best."

entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""What is the meaning of this? You c..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is the meaning of this? You can't do that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I thought this constitution is sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thought this constitution is supposed to reflect the will of the Rizian people."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""When did you decide on that, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "When did you decide on that, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I wish my party had been included..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish my party had been included in that conversation."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I wish my party had been included..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish my party had been included in that conversation."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""This does not reflect the will of..."
entries.dialogueText: "This does not reflect the will of the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've respected the will of the peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've respected the will of the people enough today. As the monarch, I will appoint Daria as the prime minister. End of discussion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are about to enter the hall, Ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are about to enter the hall, Manus. Please keep your act down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Madam de Rava was an integral figu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Madam de Rava was an integral figure in passing these reforms. I promised her she would be rewarded, and I am keeping that promise."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've respected the will of the peo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've respected the will of the people enough today. As the monarch, I will appoint Manus as the prime minister. End of discussion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are about to enter the hall, Da..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are about to enter the hall, Daria. Please keep your act down."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry. It still does.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. It still does."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There was no conversation. As the..."
entries.dialogueText: "There was no conversation. As the monarch, I will appoint whoever I want."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, the aides opened the door..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, the aides opened the doors and we entered the hall. Massive cameras were filming us as we walked inside.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, we stand at the dawn of a n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we stand at the dawn of a new era in the history of our nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I gestured for silence."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured for silence.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stood there for a whole minute as..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood there for a whole minute as the delegates applauded vigorously.
entries.menuText: Wait for the applause to stop.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is with a heart full of hope an..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is with a heart full of hope and a mind conscious of the demands of the democratic movement that I address you on this momentous occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is with a heart full of hope an..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is with a heart full of hope and a mind conscious of the demands of a new constitution made by the people, that I address you on this momentous occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Today, we reaffirm our unwavering..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we reaffirm our unwavering commitment to the principles that are the bedrock of any great society—participation in politics, liberty, and the rule of law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In the spirit of our timeless prin..."
entries.dialogueText: "In the spirit of our timeless principles, I stand before you, not as a ruler, but as a fellow Rizian."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On this historic day, we are remin..."
entries.dialogueText: "On this historic day, we are reminded of the enduring legacy of our kingdom—a legacy rich in tradition and bound by the unbreakable spirit of these lands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I believe Rizia was in need of a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe Rizia was in need of a constitution that reflects our collective aspirations for a just, equitable, and democratic society."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Change, as we know, is the only co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Change, as we know, is the only constant in the march of time. It is the harbinger of progress, the catalyst for innovation, and the doorway to new possibilities."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Embracing change is not just an op..."
entries.dialogueText: "Embracing change is not just an option; it is our imperative if we are to stride confidently into the future that beckons us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Throughout the ages, our beloved c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Throughout the ages, our beloved country has been guided by the steady hand of the monarchy, a lineage that has weathered the storms of time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet, the very essence of our natio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet, the very essence of our nation is not defined by the constancy of its rulers but by the indomitable spirit of its people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Because the very essence of our na..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because the very essence of our nation is not defined by the constancy of its rulers but by the indomitable spirit of its people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And the very essence of our nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the very essence of our nation is not defined by the constancy of its rulers but by the indomitable spirit of its people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The world around us is changing. N..."
entries.dialogueText: "The world around us is changing. Nations are awakening to the clarion call of freedom and representation, recognizing that the true strength of a country lies in the collective will of its citizens."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is in this light that I, your m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is in this light that I, your monarch, have resolved to embrace the winds of change."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Therefore, I decided to give my su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Therefore, I decided to give my support to the democratic movement in drafting a new constitution for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With this in mind, we all must giv..."
entries.dialogueText: "With this in mind, we all must give a solemn pledge to ensure that the voice of every citizen is heard, and the rights of every individual are protected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By establishing a head of governme..."
entries.dialogueText: "By establishing a head of government and vesting legislative powers in this House, the people, we are not just reforming our governance. We are fixing it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as I said that, the aides b..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as I said that, the aides brought the constitution and displayed it to the delegates, prompting more applause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are gathered here, not to witne..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are gathered here, not to witness the diminishing of the crown, but to celebrate the empowerment of the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are establishing, for the first..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are establishing, for the first time in our history, the office of the Prime Minister, a head of government chosen from among the representatives of the people, to lead the executive branch with diligence and integrity."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In embracing these reforms, I am m..."
entries.dialogueText: "In embracing these reforms, I am mindful of the profound responsibility that comes with leadership -- the responsibility to put the welfare of the nation and its people above all else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is a responsibility that I embr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a responsibility that I embrace not with a sense of loss, but with the deepest sense of honor and purpose."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I embrace this evolution, not as a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I embrace this evolution, not as a departure from our cherished traditions, but as an affirmation of their enduring relevance. This constitution does not signify an end but a beginning -- a harmonious blending of the old and the new."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This act of endorsing this constit..."
entries.dialogueText: "This act of endorsing this constitution is about ensuring that the legacy we leave for future generations is one of a society that values dialogue over decree, consensus over command, and the common good over individual gain."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This House will be the crucible in..."
entries.dialogueText: "This House will be the crucible in which the laws of our land are forged, ensuring that every statute reflects the collective will of the Rizian people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "In consenting to this constitution,..."
entries.dialogueText: In consenting to this constitution, I do not relinquish my love for this country; rather, I reaffirm my commitment to serve it and its people with every fiber of my being."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let the pages of history remember..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the pages of history remember this day as the moment when we chose not just to change, but to evolve; not just to promise, but to deliver; not just to dream, but to achieve."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we chart this new course, let u..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we chart this new course, let us be guided by the democratic principles that are now enshrined in our constitution."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At this moment, I am reminded that..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this moment, I am reminded that true leadership is not about wielding power; it is about empowering others."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Honorable delegates, I now entrust..."
entries.dialogueText: "Honorable delegates, I now entrust my power to you, the elected voice of our people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With the power vested in me by tra..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the power vested in me by tradition and lineage, I declare the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law -- adopting a true constitutional monarchy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hereby announce that the new con..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby announce that the new constitution was signed and is currently in place."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I held up the silk sash for everyon..."
entries.dialogueText: I held up the silk sash for everyone to see.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In this spirit of renewal and with..."
entries.dialogueText: "In this spirit of renewal and with the power vested in me, I hereby announce the appointment of the new head of government..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In accordance with the new constit..."
entries.dialogueText: "In accordance with the new constitution, I shall appoint a new head of government until the elections..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In appointing a new head of govern..."
entries.dialogueText: "In appointing a new head of government, we turn a page in our history, embracing a governance of the people, by the people."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As for the first Prime Minister of..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for the first Prime Minister of Rizia... This individual is someone who embodies the principles we hold dear and possesses the vision to lead our nation into a promising future..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room hung on my every word, the..."
entries.dialogueText: The room hung on my every word, the air thick with anticipation.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appoint Manus Sazon as interim P..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appoint Manus Sazon as interim Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appoint Daria de Rava as interim..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appoint Daria de Rava as interim Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A murmur of disapproval rippled thr..."
entries.dialogueText: A murmur of disapproval rippled through the chamber as he made his way to the podium.

entries.dialogueText: "To the future -- a future that we will build together, on the solid foundation of this new charter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God bless Rizia, and long live the..."
entries.dialogueText: "God bless Rizia, and long live the Kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May the bonds that unite us as a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "May the bonds that unite us as a people grow ever stronger, and may our nation flourish under the guiding principles of this new constitution."

entries.title: Narrator: "Another round of applause broke out..."
entries.dialogueText: Another round of applause broke out -- this time for much longer.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stood next to her as the applause..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood next to her as the applause subsided.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took a step back, allowing him to..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a step back, allowing him to take center stage.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I took a step back, allowing her to..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a step back, allowing her to take center stage.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, delegates, and fello..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, delegates, and fellow citizens, I am deeply honored by the trust placed in me. This is a momentous day for democracy and liberty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I am proud to have represented the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud to have represented the democratic movement to this day, and I am overjoyed to see such a transfer of power finally take place."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our path forward will be built on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our path forward will be built on dialogue, on the collective wisdom of this assembly, and on the aspirations of our people."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Your Majesty, delegates, and fello..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, delegates, and fellow citizens, I am deeply honored by the trust placed in me. This is a momentous day, not only for me, but for our great kingdom."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Together, we will embark on a jour..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we will embark on a journey of transformation, grounded in the principles of tradition, equity, and prosperity for all."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""We will face challenges, no doubt,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will face challenges, no doubt, but in our unity, we will find strength."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The delegates rose in a standing ov..."
entries.dialogueText: The delegates rose in a standing ovation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The delegates rose in a standing ov..."
entries.dialogueText: The delegates rose in a standing ovation.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I promise to represent the interes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise to represent the interests of the Rizian people -- regardless of their economic or cultural backgrounds and uphold the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law during my tenure as Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I swear that I will serve my duty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear that I will serve my duty with diligence until the upcoming elections, when Rizia will finally elect their own government."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I promise to represent the interes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise to represent the interests of the Rizian people and uphold the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law during my tenure as Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I swear that I will serve my duty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear that I will serve my duty to the Crown with diligence until the upcoming elections."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Thank you. Glovurius axa Rizia!""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. Glovurius axa Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After taking the applause in, toget..."
entries.dialogueText: After taking the applause in, together, we walked towards the balcony to face the crowd that had gathered outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was done. My signature, the Hous..."
entries.dialogueText: It was done. My signature, the House approval and now a broadcast declaration. It was a point of no return.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I joined the crowd of people g..."
entries.dialogueText: When I joined the crowd of people gathered inside the building, I was immediately greeted by Adarfo Sotelato, who took me to the ministerial chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Followed by security, we entered th..."
entries.dialogueText: Followed by security, we entered the room. The new constitution of Rizia had been laid out on a table in the center.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we exchanged handshakes and form..."
entries.dialogueText: As we exchanged handshakes and formalities with each other, Adarfo leaned in and whispered in my ear.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Glad you made it. I half-expected..."
entries.dialogueText: "Glad you made it. I half-expected you to backtrack at the last minute."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo guided me through the corrid..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo guided me through the corridors of the parliament towards the main hall.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before we entered inside, the aides..."
entries.dialogueText: Before we entered inside, the aides handed me a ceremonial silk sash with blue and golden stripes, to be presented to the first prime minister.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Adarfo quickly snatched the sash fr..."
entries.dialogueText: Adarfo quickly snatched the sash from me.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I'll have that, thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll have that, thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, he rushed towards the doo..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, he rushed towards the doors and entered the hall without waiting for me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He immediately stepped onto the pod..."
entries.dialogueText: He immediately stepped onto the podium and displayed his ceremonial sash as massive cameras filmed him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I decided to let it be and position..."
entries.dialogueText: I decided to let it be and positioned myself by the side of the hall.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "When I started walking in the direc..."
entries.dialogueText: When I started walking in the direction of the podium, several men grabbed my arms and stopped me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Unhand me! I am your King!""
entries.dialogueText: "Unhand me! I am your King!"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I hereby announce that His Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hereby announce that His Majesty, King Romus Toras, has signed the Constitution and appointed me as the Prime Minister of Rizia!"

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Ladies and gentlemen!""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What the hell?""
entries.dialogueText: "What the hell?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Sotelato! I have yet to offici..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sotelato! I have yet to officially appoint you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I followed behind him."
entries.dialogueText: I followed behind him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you think you're doing?""
entries.dialogueText: "What do you think you're doing?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let me go immediately and I'll for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let me go immediately and I'll forget this happened."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not resist them."
entries.dialogueText: I did not resist them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly, the hall broke into massi..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly, the hall broke into massive applause.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Today, we stand at the dawn of a n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, we stand at the dawn of a new era in the history of our nation."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I am deeply honored by the trust p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am deeply honored by the trust placed in me in overseeing this revolutionary change."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I am proud to have represented the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am proud to have represented the common people of Rizia, and I am overjoyed to see such a transfer of power finally take place."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Our path forward will be built on..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our path forward will be built on great transformations and reversal of historical injustices, all for the benefit of the Rizian people."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The RPP delegates rose in a standin..."
entries.dialogueText: The RPP delegates rose in a standing ovation.

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I promise to fight for the interes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I promise to fight for the interests of the Rizian working class, and uphold the Rizian Charter of Fundamental Law during my tenure as Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""I swear that I will serve my duty..."
entries.dialogueText: "I swear that I will serve my duty with diligence until the upcoming elections, when the citizens of Rizia will finally elect their own government."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Adarfo Sotelato
entries.title: Adarfo Sotelato: ""According to this new constitution..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to this new constitution, the nobility will no longer have any power nor privilege over the governance of this country."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""This is it, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "This is it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I hope everything was worth it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope everything was worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Circumstances have changed, Mr. Sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Circumstances have changed, Mr. Sazon. The only way to pass these reforms was to guarantee Baroness De Rava the position of Prime Minister."
